candidate.educational_objective: Relate aPTT monitoring to response-based dose adjustment during therapeutic IV unfractionated heparin therapy.

options.A: To guide heparin dose adjustment using coagulation-test response
options.B: To measure the client’s serum potassium concentration
options.D: To replace all platelet-count monitoring during heparin therapy

candidate.rationale: The current heparin label directs clinicians to adjust dosage according to coagulation-test results and to follow aPTT during continuous IV infusion, initially about every 4 hours and then at appropriate intervals.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Heparin dosage is adjusted according to coagulation tests; aPTT is followed during continuous IV infusion.
candidate.source_locator: Dosage and Administration, Section 2.3 > Laboratory Monitoring for Efficacy and Safety
candidate.source_version_date: Current DailyMed Version 20 published July 6, 2026; prescribing information revised January 2025
candidate.stem: Why is aPTT followed during a therapeutic continuous IV unfractionated heparin infusion?
